title: Don't Mind Them
description: They are watching, Don't look back.
body:
"**_Don't mind them_**" is a fun **kitchen sink** with many fun and also scary mods  
join a world filled with adventure and find out stuff about the world you would never excpect  
It adds **new ores** like **Null404** and **mobs** lurking around like the **Nulloid** and **many new accessories** with the "_Accessories_" mod  
Modpack currently contains mods like "_The NULL_", "_Create Fly_", "_Accessories_" and "_Daily Dad_"  
  
![Sandy sounds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pFQOt9EW/images/8d784d56c5047302d1cc56977c7783f718ee8e85.png)
  
**WARNING: MODPACK CONTAINS HORROR MODS LIKE "The NULL" AND "From The Fog"... EXCPECT THINGS TO BE A LITTLE SCARY**  

If you want to know what mods this modpack has, you can just click on the latest version in [versions](https://modrinth.com/modpack/dont-mind-them/versions) and under "dependencies" you should be able to see the current mod list (Idk tho)  
...  
  
~~They are watching  
Don't look back~~
